purpose: Primary product hero visual — 3/4 angle showcasing Creative Coral colorway and all interaction zones
prompt: Product hero render of 'VibeFlow', a compact 65% layout input device for creative professionals. 3/4 angle view from front-left showing the rounded rectangular body (295×110×20mm, 12mm corner radius). Creative Coral colorway: coral #E8735A removable shell panels with visible seam line 2mm inset from edge, amber #F5A623 glossy rotary knob top-right with indicator dot, surface #F2EDE8 matte keycap area. Left edge: semi-transparent touch strip with subtle internal glow. Right of spacebar: 3 AI key caps with coral #E8735A accent and subtle icons. Low-profile rounded cherry keycaps with matte top and subtle dish, graphite #4A464D keycap sides. Magnetic expansion port visible on right side edge. Matte body finish with gloss knob and semi-transparent touch zone. Product name 'VibeFlow' in geometric sans-serif bold at bottom-left, tagline 'Express Intent' in medium weight below. Warm neutral background #F2EDE8. Soft directional lighting from upper-left with gentle contact shadows.
negative_prompt: RGB rainbow lighting, gaming keyboard, aggressive angles, pure white background, pure black background, transparent case, neural-net graphics, glowing nodes, hex patterns, dark moody lighting
